Part.name: Duplet hull — 3 zones
Part.description: Long Oplot-style hull ERA with three separately expendable zones and a slight raised centre. Estimated size 1324 x 300 mm, about 110.2 kg. Each eligible hit consumes only its zone; the other zones remain active. Up to 55% less remaining HEAT penetration and 20% less APFSDS penetration per intact zone. Vehicle paint and camouflage, tapered ends and bolted mounting tabs. Place the mounting tabs against the hull and the closed protective face outward. Freely move, rotate, mirror and duplicate. Return to Edit to restore all zones. Gameplay approximation; no tandem simulation. Spent mounts, passive collision and mass remain.
